summary: No Limitts rebrand tested. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass. Team overview PDF (2 pages) and staff profile PDF (1 page) are valid, the logo is on page 1 only (top-left, y<=112pt) and no text overlaps it (rendered and checked by eye). Auth checks: 401/403 for no token or employee, 404 for an unknown user. Frontend (375x667): login-brand-logo shows; home-welcome-card shows the greeting, first name (Alex! for admin, Erin! for employee), date, 4 coloured dots and the tree image. All 4 Nunito weights load (document.fonts all 'loaded'). Swept 21 screens (Chat, Certificates, Socials, Library, Tasks, Events, Policies, Team, Notifications, Ask AI, Upload certificate, staff profile, plans-overview, new-chat, updates, cpd, forms, places, leaderboard, pathway, compliance): no crashes or page errors, and every text node uses Nunito (no fallback font found). Typing works in assistant-input, new-chat-search-input (filtering works), chat-message-input and compose-title-input (task). No react-native Text/TextInput imports are left outside the wrapper. No deprecated Expo packages were checked/found in the changed files.

issues: assets/images/brand-mark.png (tree crop of the logo) still has fragments of the purple 'N' and the orange peace-sign letters at its bottom edge. They show as small marks under the tree trunk in the welcome card. Re-crop the image a few px higher or mask the bottom.

The seeded DB data still says 'StaffHub' (pinned update 'Welcome to StaffHub' with author 'StaffHub'). Not in code, only in the DB, so it needs a data update for a full rebrand. /app/memory/test_credentials.md title also says StaffHub.

critical_code_review_comments: text.tsx brandFont: sets fontWeight 'normal' and maps weight to a font file. Fine. Italic styles have no italic Nunito file, so italic is synthesised on web and may not show on native. Minor.
_layout.tsx returns null until fonts load. If loading fails (fontError), the app still renders with the fallback font. OK.
pdf_brand.add_logo re-opens and re-serialises the PDF on every request. Acceptable for these sizes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Erin Employee (user_testemp001) is not returned by /api/users, so new-chat search for 'Erin' is empty by design. Use 'Saraya' to test search. PDF text extraction turns ff/fi into ligatures (ﬀ, ﬁ), so assert on names, not on 'Staff profile'.
